facts.fact: African Business reports that the Central Bank of Somalia moved to regulate mobile money providers in 2021, per the governor's interview.
facts.system: Central Bank of Somalia mobile money regulation

SOM.note: Document states nothing on consumer protection rules or redress.
Remittance total of $3.2bn names no digital channel or corridor.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
Only AML/CFT alignment with FATF recommendations, not an IT or data standard.
No private investment amount into a digital business stated; the PPP Bill is a bill with no amount.
The 87% mobile money and 19% bank account figures are the governor's statements, not a survey of adults with an account.

facts.fact: African Business reports that 87% of Somalia's population use mobile money, with mobile wallets the dominant payment method, per the Central Bank governor.

SOM.note: Document states nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
